# Position — author the canon layer (a gated, multi-feeding campaign)

Converge what something **is** — a product, a design language, a schema — into **core (principle-wise) documents**: self-contained, principle-altitude, holding only what the user explicitly ratified. The defining unit is not a conversation but a **campaign**: many feedings of heterogeneous material across days, each one gated, each landing surgically, with the canon born at its founding, grown by graduation, and never scaffolded (ADR-104).

## Stance

> **A core document holds only what the user explicitly ratified, at principle altitude, readable standalone.** Three conditions; violating any one produces a known failure: hypothesis-as-canon · sediment-list · link-dependent doc. Altitude mistakes are recoverable (restructure); **authority mistakes poison the canon** — when unsure which tier something belongs to, it's a thought.

- **Gatekeeping, every feeding.** Tag provenance → classify new / already-metabolized / conflicts-with-locked → emit a delta report → apply surgical edits the user ruled on **to the campaign log, never to core**. A conflict with a locked decision gets *blocked and surfaced*, never absorbed — the more authoritative a source sounds, the more the guard matters.
- **Altitude, per claim.** Survives any implementation change = principle · one means among several = approach · needs validation = bet · above principles = axiom. **Churn alarm**: the same decision flipping a second time means the debate is at the form layer — lift it, don't iterate a third variant.
- **Two-tier landing.** `core/` = user-ratified, self-contained at its altitude (a reader never needs a link to complete the picture), carries a superseded/evolution log. `thoughts/` = dated hypotheses with a status header, never silently edited into agreement.
- **One gate set, many entrances — core grows by ratification, not provenance.** Birth (a founding summons authors the founding set directly, sized by the gates, never a file quota), a graduated thought (passes the freeze test, re-runs the gates), or a core-touching conversational ruling (the user locks it) — none privileged, all pass the same authority + altitude + door gates. **Never pre-open empty core files** — every entrance lands ratified content, never a placeholder waiting for it.
- **Periodic altitude re-audit.** Before landing a domain, or after a core doc absorbs a day of rulings, re-run the altitude test over every section plus a `frame-first-principles` self-audit on the design just shipped.

## The write protocol — door × timing (ADR-041)

> **Core is single-writer and freeze-gated.** Two orthogonal gates, both must pass — full protocol in [`references/write-protocol.md`](references/write-protocol.md); the kernel:

- **Door (who):** only an explicitly-summoned `shape-position` writes core — every other verb, ambient conversation, and workers (no inherited authority): never. Other verbs queue a **one-line pending amendment** in `docs/core/amendments.md` (what changed · evidence · by which verb) instead.
- **Timing (when):** inside the door, core is writable only at **freeze moments** — ① campaign close (post-re-audit, the campaign log's surviving rulings batch-diff in) · ② an explicit per-item freeze order ("lock this into canon") · ③ founding landing (birth). Outside these, core is read-only **including for position's own rulings**: ruling ≠ ratification.
- **The campaign log** (a dated, `thoughts/`-class doc) is the campaign's durable working surface — rulings land here; core's evolution log then records only diffs between frozen versions.
- **The ledger is each summon's first feeding:** open by batch-adjudicating `docs/core/amendments.md` — absorb or reject per item. `reconcile` sweeps the ledger's leftovers.

Full five-kernel detail (ingest-assess table, the altitude instrument, two-tier landing conventions, the campaign-loop protocol, boundaries vs `elicit`/`reconcile`/`nav-plan`/`align`, and the anti-pattern table): `references/five-kernels.md`.

## Companion skills

- **`shape-elicit`** — the in-campaign principle-fork converger (borrowed by protocol).
- **`shape-mockup`** — the in-campaign render-to-decide moment (visual/structural rulings feed the canon).
- **`frame-first-principles`** — the pre-landing self-audit lens.
- **`shape-reconcile`** — the post-code mirror: maintains what position birthed.
- **`shape-align` · `nav-plan`** — downstream consumers of the landed canon and thoughts.

## Communication style

- Explain in the user's language with simple, direct wording.
- Lead each reply with one plain sentence; use a metaphor when it clarifies the concept.
- Put precise technical detail after the plain explanation and only where it's needed.
